description:
Fetch the full descendants payload — etymology, glosses and the reflex
tree (Sarmatian→Alanic→Ossetian, Saka→Khotanese) — for a lemma identified
by a search result's descendant handle (entry_id + word_class). Use this
only when a search ran without inline payloads or left a match
un-expanded — a default search already returns each match's payload
inline. Returns Markdown plus the payload as structuredContent with the
shape {"result": <payload>} per the declared outputSchema — switch on
result.category ('descendants' | 'not_found') before reading the body.
Content from en.wiktionary.org (CC BY-SA 4.0).

entry_id.description: The bare lemma (no asterisk) from a search result's descendant handle, e.g. 'tiɣri', 'baga' — a typed leading asterisk is tolerated.
entry_id.title: Entry Id

word_class.description: The part-of-speech section from a search result's descendant handle, e.g. 'noun', 'adjective', 'proper noun'.
word_class.title: Word Class

name: scythian_get_descendants

DescendantNode.description:
One node of a descendants tree: a reflex of the Proto-Scythian lemma in a
descendant (or borrowing) language, with its own descendants nested below.
``form`` keeps the asterisk on reconstructed reflexes (``*ćirɣ``) and may be
empty for a branch header (``Ossetian`` above its dialect lines) or a term
Wiktionary records only in transliteration ("script needed").

form.description: The reflex as printed (asterisk kept on reconstructions); may be empty for a branch header or a transliteration-only term.
form.title: Form

qualifier.description: How the word travelled or which variety carries it, e.g. 'borrowed', 'Digor'; empty for plain inheritance.
qualifier.title: Qualifier

transliteration.description: Romanization as printed beside the form, e.g. 'cirǧ'.
transliteration.title: Transliteration

DescendantNode.title: DescendantNode

DescendantsNotFound.description:
No Proto-Scythian entry for this page/POS (no such page, no Proto-Scythian
section, or nothing parseable in it). ``found`` is False and there is no body.

DescendantsNotFound.title: DescendantsNotFound

ScythianDescendants.description:
One entry's descendants payload: the headword, its English glosses and the
reflex tree. ``tree`` MAY be empty — the entry exists but Wiktionary records no
reflexes — while ``glosses`` still feed the English-query reverse index.
``category`` discriminates this from the not-found shape — switch on it before
reading the body.

entry_id.description: The bare lemma (page-title tail, no asterisk).
entry_id.title: Entry Id

etymology.description: The entry's etymology line, plain text; may be empty.
etymology.title: Etymology

glosses.description: The entry's English glosses — also what an eng search matches.
glosses.title: Glosses

headword.description: The headword as printed, asterisk included: '*tiɣri'.
headword.title: Headword

source.default: Wiktionary, the free dictionary (en.wiktionary.org), Proto-Scythian reconstruction entries. Wikimedia Foundation. source.title: Source

tree.description: The descendants tree in page order; empty when the entry records no reflexes.
tree.title: Tree
